measurements.note: "369,993" may be a thousands separator or a decimal one; read as 369.993 because 369.993 GPa is outside anything this property reaches Corrected against the source: the sheet heads its tables "(Printed, non-injection molded)"; the import filed the row as a raw material value. Flagged physically implausible: the sheet prints an "E-Modulus" of 369,993 MPa beside a tensile strength at yield of 24,617 MPa at a strain at yield of 7,078 %, whose ratio is that modulus: the slope to yield, not a PLA's elastic modulus (about 3 GPa). Kept as printed; it backs nothing.
